title.narrative: Yr3 Fostering an Ecological Transition in Peten

description.narrative: This FAO EU-TEI project will contribute to sustainable agriculture and increase systemic resilience to climate change in Petén, Guatemala. The project includes activities on sustainable agriculture practices, business management, gender, ecosystems and climate change. Supporting 6 women’s organisations to produce nutritious food from native crops. In addition this project is in an especially important area, in a buffer zone south of the Maya Biosphere Forest Reserve, which covers one fifth of Guatemala’s land area, and is the largest American forest north of the Amazon. This grant will implement climate change adaptation in agricultural models and practices to improve climate resilience in food systems. It will increase support to smallholder farmers on conservation agriculture, develop infrastructure for tree nurseries and support to women’s producer organisations, which will include procurement of solar dryers and other equipment required to bring sustainable food products to market.
